cpr_01_confirm.text: Don't panic. 911 CAD dispatch has been alerted with your exact GPS location. We need to start CPR immediately! Lay them flat on firm ground.

cpr_02_agonal.text: Do not stop. Gasping is agonal breathing, not normal breathing. Kneel beside their chest immediately.

cpr_03_position.text: Put heel of hand on center of chest, lock your elbows straight.

cpr_04_start_beat.text: Ready: 3... 2... 1... PUSH! Push hard and fast to the beat! Push down two inches, let the chest rise fully every time.

cpr_05_recoil.text: Keep pushing to the beat. Allow full chest recoil. Do not lean on the chest.

cpr_07_aed.text: If anyone is with you, send them to find an AED right now. Do not stop pushing.

cpr_06_paramedics.text: Stop compressions and step back. Let the paramedics take over. The emergency timeline is saved on your screen. Take a slow, deep breath.

qa_rib_pop.text: A rib pop can happen during effective CPR. Do not stop, keep pushing to the beat.

qa_bed_surface.text: Move them to a firm floor if you can do so safely. Then resume pushing.

qa_vomit.text: Roll them onto their side, clear the mouth, roll them back and immediately resume compressions.

qa_fallback.text: Continue chest compressions to the beat. Emergency services will guide further.

qa_tired.text: If someone else can take over, switch quickly. If you are alone, keep pushing to the beat.

qa_pressing_force.text: Pushing at least two inches deep is necessary to pump blood. Keep pushing hard.

bleed_step1_pressure.text: Call 911 on speaker! Apply heavy direct pressure on the wound now.

bleed_step2_tourniquet.text: Apply tourniquet two to three inches above wound, tighten until bleeding stops.

anaph_step1_epipen.text: Call 911 now! Locate the EpiPen immediately.

cpr_adult_step1_call911.text: Don't panic. 911 CAD dispatch has been alerted with your exact GPS location. We need to start CPR immediately! Lay them flat on firm ground.

cpr_adult_step2_posture.text: Put heel of hand on center of chest, lock your elbows straight.

cpr_adult_step3_compressions.text: Ready: 3... 2... 1... PUSH! Push hard and fast to the beat! Push down two inches, let the chest rise fully every time.

cpr_child_step1_call911.text: Don't panic. 911 CAD dispatch has been alerted with your exact GPS location. We need to start CPR immediately! Lay them flat on firm ground.

cpr_child_step2_posture.text: Use one or two hands on center of chest, lock elbows straight.

qa_ambulance_dispatch_status.text: 911 CAD dispatch has been alerted with your exact GPS location. Keep pushing hard.

cpr_child_step3_compressions.text: Compress to the beat! 30 compressions followed by 2 gentle breaths.

cpr_infant_step1_call911.text: Don't panic. 911 CAD dispatch has been alerted with your exact GPS location. We need to start CPR immediately! Place infant on a flat surface.

cpr_infant_step2_posture.text: Place infant on flat surface. Use two fingers in center of chest.

cpr_infant_step3_compressions.text: Compress gently 1.5 inches deep at 110 BPM. 30 compressions then 2 gentle puffs.

choke_adult_step1_assess.text: Call 911 immediately! Ask: Are you choking? Can you speak?

choke_adult_step2_heimlich.text: Stand behind them. Make a fist above navel, pull sharply inward and upward.

choke_child_step1_assess.text: Call 911 immediately on speaker! Kneel behind child, encourage them to cough.

choke_child_step2_thrusts.text: Kneel behind child. Make a fist above navel, give quick upward thrusts.

choke_infant_step1_call911.text: Call 911 on speaker! Never do a blind finger sweep.

choke_infant_step2_slaps.text: Lay infant face down along forearm. Give 5 firm back slaps, then turn over for 5 chest thrusts.

anaph_step2_inject.text: Inject into outer mid-thigh, push until it clicks, hold for three full seconds.

od_step1_narcan.text: Call 911 on speaker! Grab Narcan or Naloxone nasal spray.

od_step2_administer.text: Spray full dose into one nostril. Place in recovery position.

qa_agent_identity.text: I am Agent 3, right here with you. Tell me what is happening or ask anything.

qa_help_general.text: I am right here with you. Tell me what happened—are they awake and breathing?

qa_good_samaritan_legal.text: Good Samaritan laws protect you. You are legally protected when attempting emergency CPR.

qa_rib_cracking.text: A rib pop can happen during effective CPR. Do not stop. Keep pushing to the beat.

qa_technique_verification.text: You are doing great. Keep hands centered, elbows locked, and push to the beat.

qa_what_to_do_next.text: Keep doing chest compressions in center of chest. Focus on the 110 beat.

qa_confusion_guidance.text: Stay calm, I am guiding you. Hands in center of chest, lock elbows, and push to the beat.

qa_patient_alive_doubt.text: Do not give up. Compressions are pumping oxygen to their brain right now. Keep pushing.

qa_blood_fluid.text: Wipe blood quickly from mouth, then continue chest compressions immediately without stopping.

qa_hand_placement.text: Heel of your hand right in center of chest between nipples. Lock elbows straight.

qa_mouth_to_mouth.text: Hands-only CPR is just as effective for adults. Keep pushing continuously to the beat.

qa_exhaustion_stopping.text: Do not stop compressions. If another person is with you, swap rescuers without pausing.

qa_vomit_airway.text: Roll them onto their side quickly to clear mouth, then return to back immediately.

qa_aed_wet_surface.text: Dry victim chest with a towel or shirt before applying AED pads. It is safe.

qa_aed_pacemaker.text: Place AED pad at least one inch away from visible pacemaker lump. Continue CPR.

qa_checking_pulse.text: Do not waste time checking pulse. If unresponsive and not breathing, continue CPR immediately.

qa_tourniquet_pain.text: Tourniquets must hurt to work. Tighten until bright red spurting bleeding stops completely.

qa_expose_bare_chest.text: Expose the bare chest immediately so you can see where to place your hands.

qa_untrained_novice.text: Don't panic, I will guide you. Heel on center of chest, lock elbows, and push to the beat.

qa_too_late_doubt.text: Start compressions immediately. It is never too late to try to save their life.

qa_patient_moan_sound.text: Do not stop unless they push your hands away and breathe normally. Keep pushing.

qa_agonal_breathing_sound.text: Do not stop. Gasping is agonal breathing, not normal breathing. Keep pushing to the beat.

qa_paramedic_arrival_debrief.text: The paramedics are in charge now. Step back and take a deep breath. You did everything right.
